skill.summary: Search and download ebooks from jbiaojerry.github.io/ebook-treasure-chest. Use when the user wants to find ebooks, search for books by title/author/category,...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of ebook-search.
- Search and download from a collection of 24,000+ Chinese and English ebooks.
- Supports search by title, author, category, or keywords; browse categories.
- Find download links for epub, mobi, and azw3 formats.
- Local database cache updates automatically every 24 hours.
